property_summary: For any target and amount, the reference contract's sendMoney returns success (does not revert) even if the target's fallback reverts because it uses a low-level call with checked return; the mutant using transfer will instead revert when the target's payable fallback reverts, causing sendMoney to fail for some inputs.
change_summary: Change the call to use transfer instead of low-level call, which will revert on failure and does not forward all gas, altering whether sendMoney succeeds and thus the contract balance after the call.
